# Security Policy

## Supported versions
Only the latest released version receives security fixes.

## Reporting a vulnerability
Please **do not** open a public issue for security problems.

Report vulnerabilities privately with GitHub's
[private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/craftgame-net/metro/security/advisories/new):
open the Security tab and choose "Report a vulnerability".

Include what is needed to reproduce the issue: the Metro and Paper versions, the steps and the
impact. We aim to acknowledge reports within a few days and to fix confirmed issues in the next
release.

## Scope
The Metro plugin code and its permissions, for example a player doing something without the
permission that should be required. Problems in Paper, Minecraft or other plugins belong to
those projects.
